text: Checking that the probe output really is normalized (mean ≈ 0, var ≈ 1 per token), saving the reconstructed FFN inputs for layer 0, then switching the probe to layer 1.

import json
exec(open(WORK/'probe.py').read())
def save_probe(L, passdir, hidx):
    Z = np.load(WORK/passdir/f'token_hidden_L{hidx}.npy'); M = np.load(WORK/passdir/'attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
    z = Z[M]
    print('mean', np.abs(z.mean(1)).max(), 'var', z.var(1).min(), z.var(1).max(), z.shape)
    g = base(f"roberta.encoder.layer.{L}.attention.output.LayerNorm.weight"); b = base(f"roberta.encoder.layer.{L}.attention.output.LayerNorm.bias")
    a = z*g + b
    # also record which rows are CLS
    iscls = np.zeros(M.shape, bool); iscls[:,0]=True
    np.save(WORK/f'ffn_in_L{L}.npy', a.astype(np.float32)); np.save(WORK/f'ffn_in_L{L}_iscls.npy', iscls[M])
save_probe(0, 'pass_4', 1)
probe_off(0)
probe_on(1); print(edits(), structure()['layers'])
